# SkeletonCard

A loading stand-in with the same shape as ProductCard, so the grid doesn't jump when products arrive.

`IK.SkeletonCard` · Shopping

## Use

```jsx
<IK.SkeletonCard />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.SkeletonCard"></x-import>
```

## Props (SkeletonCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `boolean` |  |
| `lines` | `number` |  |
| `aspect` | `string` | CSS aspect-ratio of the media block. Default "4 / 5" (matches ProductCard). |
